Volunteered for customer support, resolving speed and screen issues on the spot
Escalated unresolved issues to the dev team and documented resolution cases as deliverables
Analyzed recurring complaints and turned them into UX/UI improvements and maintenance screens in Nexacro
achievements: Cut average daily complaints from 15+ to around 2
Resolution-case documents were reused to handle recurrences faster
